name: ASCV
summary: ASCV is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies and trades in the direction of the prevailing market trend. It uses technical indicators to confirm trend direction and generates entry signals when momentum aligns with the trend. The EA manages positions with predefined stop-loss and take-profit levels while applying position sizing based on account equity.
summary_zh: ASCV是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，通过识别并跟随市场主趋势方向进行交易。它利用技术指标确认趋势方向，当动量与趋势一致时产生入场信号。该EA使用预定义的止损和止盈管理仓位，并根据账户净值进行仓位规模管理。
strategy_analysis: ASCV策略的核心概念是基于市场趋势方向进行顺势交易，避免逆势操作带来的风险。入场条件主要依赖技术指标的组合信号，当多个指标同时确认趋势方向且动量充足时才会开仓。出场条件包括达到预设的止盈目标、触发止损保护以及趋势反转信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用基于账户净值百分比的动态仓位计算方法，确保每笔交易的风险敞口可控。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损限额，防止单次极端行情造成过度损失。整体策略强调趋势确认的严谨性和风险暴露的可控性，但在震荡行情中可能产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the ASCV strategy is to trade in the direction of the prevailing market trend, avoiding the risks associated with counter-trend operations. Entry conditions rely on a combination of technical indicator signals, requiring multiple indicators to simultaneously confirm trend direction with sufficient momentum before opening a position. Exit conditions include reaching predefined take-profit targets, triggering stop-loss protection, and closing positions when trend reversal signals appear. Position sizing employs a dynamic calculation method based on a percentage of account equity, ensuring that risk exposure per trade remains controllable. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and daily maximum loss thresholds to prevent excessive losses from extreme market conditions. The overall strategy emphasizes rigorous trend confirmation and controlled risk exposure, though it may generate frequent false signals during ranging or choppy market conditions.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单

pros: 顺势交易逻辑清晰，符合趋势跟踪的核心理念，在大趋势行情中表现优异
具有完整的止损止盈和移动止损机制，风险控制措施较为全面
仓位管理基于账户净值动态调整，避免固定手数带来的过度风险暴露
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic aligned with core trend trading principles, performing well during strong trending markets
Complete stop-loss, take-profit, and trailing stop mechanisms providing comprehensive risk control
Dynamic position sizing based on account equity avoids excessive risk exposure from fixed lot sizes
cons: 在震荡盘整行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致连续亏损
缺少市场波动率过滤机制，在低波动率环境下可能频繁无效开仓
策略逻辑相对简单，缺乏多时间周期确认和更复杂的市场状态识别
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals in ranging or choppy markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lacks volatility filtering mechanism, potentially opening ineffective positions in low-volatility environments
Strategy logic is relatively simple, lacking multi-timeframe confirmation and more sophisticated market regime detection
improvements: 增加多时间周期趋势确认机制，提高信号质量和入场准确率
引入波动率过滤器（如ATR），在低波动率环境下减少交易频率
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend confirmation to improve signal quality and entry accuracy
Introduce a volatility filter (such as ATR) to reduce trading frequency in low-volatility environments

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，在高点差时段交易可能侵蚀利润
趋势反转时止损可能因滑点而无法按预期价格执行
risk_points_en: Lacks spread filter, trading during high-spread periods may erode profits
Stop-loss may not execute at expected price during trend reversals due to slippage
